rationale: C08 is an essentially exact drafting template for the child: both are single-sentence orders authorizing a named individual to be appointed to a competitive position in a specified department without compliance with the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Act and Rules. Only the appointee and department change. C22 and C09 concern comparable individualized exceptions to competitive civil-service requirements, but their language and administrative mechanism are less exact.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Mrs. Cressie E. Coffelt may be appointed to a competitive position in the Department of the Interior without compliance with the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Act and Rules.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Stanley C. Wollaston may be appointed to a competitive position in the Department of Labor without compliance with the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Act and Rules.
shared_material.explanation: The operative sentence is identical in structure and nearly all wording, with only the person's name and employing department substituted.
